{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter to completed orders only, excluding QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
completed = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['revenue'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute conversion rate for each channel
conversion_rates = completed.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Extract conversion rates
e_email = conversion_rates['email']
e_paid_search = conversion_rates['paid_search']

difference = e_email - e_paid_search

print(f'Email conversion rate: {e_email:.4f}')
print(f'Paid search conversion rate: {e_paid_search:.4f}')
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}')"}
